</figure>
<div id="S4.SS4.SSS0.Px3.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS4.SSS0.Px3.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Table <a href="#S4.T9" title="Table 9 ‣ Evaluation ‣ 4.4 Baseline Models ‣ 4 Technical Validation ‣ DialogPII: A multilingual dataset of synthetic dialog transcripts to detect personal information" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">9</span></a> presents the results obtained when training and evaluating the model on the curated synthetic dialogs. Overall performance was high across most languages, with an average lenient F1 score of 89.31 and an average exact F1 score of 86.82. English, German, Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian achieved lenient F1 scores above 90, indicating that the dataset supports effective multilingual learning despite substantial variation in language families and dialog scenarios. Performance was lower for Arabic and Hindi, reflecting the additional challenges posed by different scripts, morphological variation, and lower-resource language settings.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS4.SSS0.Px3.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS4.SSS0.Px3.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Table <a href="#S4.T10" title="Table 10 ‣ Evaluation ‣ 4.4 Baseline Models ‣ 4 Technical Validation ‣ DialogPII: A multilingual dataset of synthetic dialog transcripts to detect personal information" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">10</span></a> reports results obtained on the speech-transcribed version of the dataset. Compared to the original dialog data, performance decreased moderately across most languages. The average lenient F1 score decreased from 89.31 to 85.54, while the average exact F1 score decreased from 86.82 to 81.81. This reduction is expected, as automatic speech recognition introduces transcription errors that may alter entity boundaries or affect entity recognition. Nevertheless, the model maintained strong performance across the majority of languages, demonstrating that the speech-derived resources constitute a viable benchmark for studying de-identification in automatic speech recognition pipelines.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S4.SS4.SSS0.Px4" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">External Validation on Real-World Conversations</h5>

<div id="S4.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">As DialogPII consists of curated, synthetic dialogs, an important question is whether models trained on the dataset generalize beyond the generated scenarios. To investigate this, we performed an external evaluation using a subset of the CallFriend corpus <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib28" title="" class="ltx_ref">Canavan and Zipperlen (1996)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib26" title="" class="ltx_ref">Yaeger-Dror and Linguistic Data Consortium (2006)</a></cite>. We selected five English and five German telephone conversations and manually annotated their transcripts according to the DialogPII annotation guidelines. The CallFriend conversations differ substantially from the scenarios represented in DialogPII. They consist of spontaneous telephone conversations between friends and family members discussing everyday topics and therefore contain more informal language, conversational digressions, and naturally occurring speech phenomena.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Tables <a href="#S4.T11" title="Table 11 ‣ External Validation on Real-World Conversations ‣ 4.4 Baseline Models ‣ 4 Technical Validation ‣ DialogPII: A multilingual dataset of synthetic dialog transcripts to detect personal information" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">11</span></a> and <a href="#S4.T12" title="Table 12 ‣ External Validation on Real-World Conversations ‣ 4.4 Baseline Models ‣ 4 Technical Validation ‣ DialogPII: A multilingual dataset of synthetic dialog transcripts to detect personal information" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">12</span></a> present the results obtained using the baseline models trained on the synthetic dialogs and speech-transcribed dialogs, respectively. As expected, performance was lower than on the in-domain DialogPII test sets. Nevertheless, both models achieved encouraging results, particularly under the type-agnostic evaluation setting, where macro-average lenient F1 scores exceeded 83.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S4.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Several factors may contribute to the observed performance gap. First, the conversational domains represented in CallFriend differ considerably from the targeted scenarios included in DialogPII, resulting in different frequencies and distributions of sensitive entities. Second, real-world conversations contain greater linguistic variability, disfluencies, and spontaneous speech phenomena than curated synthetic dialogs. Third, certain entity formats, such as telephone numbers or postal codes, differ from the patterns represented in the synthetic data. Despite these limitations, the results suggest that models trained on DialogPII learn transferable representations of conversational sensitive information and can generalize beyond the synthetic training environment. The benchmark should therefore be viewed as evidence that the dataset provides a useful foundation for developing multilingual de-identification systems, while leaving substantial room for future work on domain adaptation and robustness to naturally occurring conversational data.</p>
</div>
<figure id="S4.T11" class="ltx_table">

<section id="S5" class="ltx_section">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_section"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_section">5 </span>Usage Notes</h3>

<div id="S5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">DialogPII is intended for research on multilingual de-identification, conversational named entity recognition, speech anonymization, and privacy-preserving natural language processing.</p>
</div>
<div id="S5.p2" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S5.p2.1" class="ltx_p">The repository provides aligned resources across text and speech modalities, allowing users to investigate:</p>
</div>
<div id="S5.p3" class="ltx_para">
<ul id="S5.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="S5.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="S5.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S5.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">multilingual sensitive information detection,</p>
</div></li>
<li id="S5.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="S5.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S5.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">automatic speech recognition robustness,</p>
</div></li>
<li id="S5.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="S5.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S5.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">annotation projection across modalities,</p>
</div></li>
<li id="S5.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="S5.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S5.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">anonymization pipelines for conversational data.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="S5.p4" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S5.p4.1" class="ltx_p">The released baseline models are optimized for conversational input and sentence-level inference. During model development, dialogs were segmented into sentence-level units prior to tokenization and prediction. Applying inference directly to long unsegmented speaker turns may reduce performance.</p>
</div>
<div id="S5.p5" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S5.p5.1" class="ltx_p">Although the dialogs were manually curated, the dataset is synthetic and generated using large language models. Consequently, linguistic patterns and conversational dynamics may differ from naturally occurring human interactions. Researchers should therefore exercise caution when transferring models trained on this dataset to real-world clinical or customer-service environments. Performance differences across languages were observed, particularly for morphologically rich and lower-resource languages such as Arabic and Hindi.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S6" class="ltx_section">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_section"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_section">6 </span>Data Availability </h3>

<div id="S6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The synthetic, as well as the transcribed dialogs, together with the annotation guidelines, are available on Zenodo<span id="footnote4" class="ltx_note ltx_role_footnote"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">4</sup><span class="ltx_note_outer"><span class="ltx_note_content"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">4</sup>
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_note">4</span>
            
            
            
          <a href="https://zenodo.org/records/20863452" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://zenodo.org/records/20863452</a></span></span></span>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S7" class="ltx_section">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_section"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_section">7 </span>Code Availability</h3>

<div id="S7.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S7.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The code of the baseline models together with some exemplary code snippets is publicly available at Hugging Face<span id="footnote5" class="ltx_note ltx_role_footnote"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">5</sup><span class="ltx_note_outer"><span class="ltx_note_content"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">5</sup>
            <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_note">5</span>
            
            
            
          <a href="https://huggingface.co/DFKI-SLT/multilingual_DialogPII_NER" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://huggingface.co/DFKI-SLT/multilingual_DialogPII_NER</a></span></span></span>. Pretrained baseline checkpoints are distributed through Hugging Face and include configuration files required for CRF-based decoding.</p>
</div>
</section>

<section id="S9" class="ltx_section">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_section"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_section">9 </span>Author Contributions </h3>

<div id="S9.p1" class="ltx_para">

<section id="S10.2" class="ltx_appendix">
<section id="S11" class="ltx_section">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_section"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_section">11 </span>Prompt to generate original dialogs</h3>

<div id="S11.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S11.p1.1" class="ltx_p">To generate original English dialogs, an LLM was used in a first step to generate different example setups including personas (see example in Table <a href="#S11.T13" title="Table 13 ‣ 11 Prompt to generate original dialogs ‣ 10 Competing Interests ‣ DialogPII: A multilingual dataset of synthetic dialog transcripts to detect personal information" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">13</span></a>), which were then inserted into a prompt to generate the complete dialogs, as presented in Figure <a href="#S11.F3" title="Figure 3 ‣ 11 Prompt to generate original dialogs ‣ 10 Competing Interests ‣ DialogPII: A multilingual dataset of synthetic dialog transcripts to detect personal information" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">3</span></a>, for police.</p>
</div>
<figure id="S11.T13" class="ltx_table">
<table id="S11.T13.2" class="ltx_tabular ltx_centering ltx_align_middle">
<tr id="S11.T13.2.1" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="S11.T13.2.1.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_align_top ltx_border_tt">
<span id="S11.T13.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_align_top" style="width:234.6pt;">
<span id="S11.T13.2.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_p">A couple from Poland (32 and 30) were approached by a woman asking them to sign a petition near Camden High Street. While the wife was distracted, the husband’s shoulder bag was unzipped. His passport, cash, and hotel keycard (Holiday Inn Express Camden Lock) were missing. They feel stupid for falling for it and are visibly upset.</span>
</span></td></tr>
<tr id="S11.T13.2.2" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="S11.T13.2.2.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_align_top ltx_border_t">
<span id="S11.T13.2.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_align_top" style="width:234.6pt;">
<span id="S11.T13.2.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_p">A Swedish man in his mid-50s was listening to live music at a street corner. When he turned to film the band, someone must have taken his wallet from his coat. He lost his Swedish national ID card, a Stockholm transit card, and a paper with his Airbnb code. He’s very calm but concerned about identity theft.</span>
</span></td></tr>
<tr id="S11.T13.2.3" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="S11.T13.2.3.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_align_top ltx_border_bb ltx_border_t">
<span id="S11.T13.2.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_align_top" style="width:234.6pt;">
<span id="S11.T13.2.3.1.1.1" class="ltx_p">A 19-year-old woman from Portugal traveling with a student group discovered her phone missing after visiting a food stand. She was trying to check Google Maps when she noticed it. The phone had a Portuguese SIM card, was tied to her student ID and had all her travel info. She’s not sure when exactly it was taken.</span>
</span></td></tr>

<span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.7.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.7.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">

<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">The dialog must sound natural, empathetic, and procedurally realistic. The police officer should ask clarifying questions about the incident and offer guidance or explain the next steps (e.g., reporting, embassy, lost documents).</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">

<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">The tourist(s) should:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.10" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">- Explain what happened.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.11" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.11.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">- Share direct identifiers (e.g., name, nationality, hotel, passport number, phone number, email).</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.12" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.12.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">- Mention indirect identifiers (e.g., travel plans, brand of phone, bank name, description of items, group structure).</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.13" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">- Possibly show signs of emotion (e.g., panic, frustration, worry, guilt).</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.14" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.15" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p15.1" class="ltx_p">Use the following setup as the basis of the report, but make the dialog vivid and immersive:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.16" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.17" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p17" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p17.1" class="ltx_p">Setup:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.18" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S11.p2.pic1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S11.p2.pic1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">{SETUP}</span>

</div>
<figure id="S11.F3" class="ltx_figure">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure">Figure 3: </span>Example prompt to generate the police dialogs.</figcaption>
</figure>
<div id="S11.p3" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S11.p3.1" class="ltx_p">For most scenarios, dialogs were generated using the LLM-based persona and scenario prompts described above.
The anamnesis scenario followed a slightly different generation procedure.
To increase clinical plausibility and variation, these dialogs were first generated in German using GRASCCO <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib21" title="" class="ltx_ref">Modersohn et al. (2022)</a></cite>, a German corpus of discharge summaries, as storyline material.
They were subsequently translated into English and then localized into the remaining target languages using the translation procedure described in Appendix B.
The AI Dashboard scenario was inspired by prior work on patient and support-person expectations in kidney transplant decision-support systems <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib20" title="" class="ltx_ref">Sassi et al. (2026)</a></cite>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S12" class="ltx_section">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_section"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_section">12 </span>Prompt to translate dialogs</h3>

<div id="S12.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S12.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The following prompt was used to translate English dialogs into a new language and an amended scenario within a different city. Information in curved brackets are placeholders and replaced dynamically.</p>
</div>

<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">

<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.2" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">

</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.3" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">TASK</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.6.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.6.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">Translate and fully localize the annotated synthetic dialog into the target language. Write the result as a verbatim transcript of a real spoken conversation, e.g. a phone call, between people living in the target country and target city if given. If local or city-specific features are uncertain, default to natural, informal spoken language, not written standard language and not exaggerated dialect. The output will be used for TTS synthesis, so do not add any comments, notes, or explanations.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">REQUIREMENTS</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.10" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">Spoken realism (highest priority)</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.11" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.11.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.11.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.11.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">Prioritize how people actually speak in everyday conversation. Use short turns, interruptions, unfinished sentences, and uneven rhythm. Allow dropped subjects, particles, fillers, hesitations, and casual phrasing where natural. Use everyday vocabulary only. Avoid literary, explanatory, formal, or polished language. Treat realism as more important than clarity or grammatical completeness.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.12" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.12.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.13" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">Careful local flavor</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.14" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.14.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.14.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">If a target city is provided, reflect local speech subtly and cautiously. Do not perform or exaggerate a dialect. Avoid strong or stereotypical regional markers if they risk being incorrect. It is better to sound locally neutral and genuinely spoken than regionally wrong.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.15" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.16" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">STRICT XML INVARIANCE (mandatory)</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.17" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.17.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.17.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p17" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p17.1" class="ltx_p">All XML annotation tags are immutable and must be treated as opaque markers. Do not rename, remove, add, or reorder any XML tags. Do not introduce new tag types or categories. Do not change tag casing, spelling, or structure. Do not change nesting or boundaries of tags. Do not add attributes or metadata to tags. Only the plain text inside existing tags may be replaced.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.18" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.19" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.19.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">Preserve annotation tags exactly</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.20" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.20.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.20.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.20.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">Keep all annotation tags unchanged, e.g. &lt;NAME&gt;...&lt;/NAME&gt;, &lt;CITY&gt;...&lt;/CITY&gt;. Their position relative to surrounding text must remain exactly the same.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.21" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.21.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.22" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.22.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">Deep cultural localization</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.23" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.23.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.23.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.23.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p23" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p23.1" class="ltx_p">Adapt the situation to fit everyday life in the target country. Replace activities, settings, or habits that would be unusual or implausible with culturally appropriate equivalents. Assume shared local context between speakers. Do not explain places, customs, weather, or routines that locals would take for granted.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.24" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.24.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.25" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.25.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p25.1" class="ltx_p">Localize all named entities</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.26" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.26.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p26" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p26.1" class="ltx_p">Replace names, streets, cities, and institutions with culturally appropriate equivalents, but only inside existing XML tags.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.27" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.27.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.28" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.28.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.28.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p28" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p28.1" class="ltx_p">Name localization rule</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.29" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.29.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.29.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.29.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.29.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p29" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p29.1" class="ltx_p">Use realistic names for the target country and its demographic diversity. Mix culturally typical local names with plausible immigrant-background names. Avoid stereotypes or implausible combinations.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.30" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.30.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.30.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.31" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.31.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.31.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p31" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p31.1" class="ltx_p">Preserve meaning and intent</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.32" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.32.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.32.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.32.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.32.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p32" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p32.1" class="ltx_p">Keep the communicative goal and emotional tone of the original dialog. Rephrase freely if needed to achieve natural spoken realism, as long as XML tags remain untouched.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.33" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.33.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.33.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.34" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.34.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.34.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p34" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p34.1" class="ltx_p">Maintain structure</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.35" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.35.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.35.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.35.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.35.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p35" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p35.1" class="ltx_p">Keep dialog turns, speaker labels, formatting, and line breaks exactly as in the original. Do not merge or split lines. Do not add empty lines unless they exist in the original.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.36" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.36.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.36.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.37" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.37.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.37.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p37" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p37.1" class="ltx_p">No additional content</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.38" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.38.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.38.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p38" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p38.1" class="ltx_p">Do not include explanations, comments, notes, or metadata. Output only the localized dialog, ready for TTS.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.39" class="ltx_p" style="width:327.1pt;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.39.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="font-size:50%;width:327.1pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="S12.p2.pic1.1.39.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:327.1pt;"></span></span></span>

<span id="S12.p2.pic1.p40.1" class="ltx_p">INPUT dialog to be localized:</span>

<section id="S13" class="ltx_section">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_section"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_section">13 </span>Data Examples</h3>

<div id="S13.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="S13.p1.1" class="ltx_p">For readability, the following examples show annotations in an inline XML-style representation.
In the released dataset, the same information is stored in JSON format with turn-local annotation offsets.</p>
</div>

    <p><strong>Tip:</strong> You can select the relevant text first, to include it in your report.</p>
    <p>Our team has already identified <a class="ltx_ref" href="https://github.com/arXiv/html_feedback/issues"

      all.</p>
